map.若三级均 −3dB，则总 −9dB、线性 ≈ 0.126 倍（约衰减到 1/8）: If all three stages are -3dB, the total is -9dB, linear ~ 0.126x (about attenuated to 1/8).
map.dB 是对数单位，级联相乘对应对数相加，故总增益为各级 dB 之和。: dB is a logarithmic unit; cascaded multiplication maps to logarithmic addition, so total gain is the sum of the stage dB values.
map.负 dB 表示衰减，如 −3dB 约衰减到 0.707 倍（一半功率）。: Negative dB indicates attenuation; for example -3dB attenuates to about 0.707x (half power).
